question.problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{2}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{2}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=5x$ for $x\in [-2,2).$ The Fourier series of the $4$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${b}_{3}.$

${b}_{3}=$ {{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the sine coefficients are given by

$$
{b}_{n}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{L}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=2$ and $f(x)=5x$ for $x\in (-2,2).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
{b}_{3}=\frac{1}{2}{\int }_{-2}^{2}(5x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

We use the integration by parts: 

$$
\begin{aligned}u=5x\, & ⇒\,{u}^{′}=5 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\, & ⇒\,v=-\frac{2}{3\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{b}_{3} & =\frac{1}{2}(uv\,{|}_{-2}^{2}-{\int }_{-2}^{2}v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-\frac{2}{3\pi }{[5x\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{-2}^{2}+\frac{10}{3\pi }{\int }_{-2}^{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{3\pi }(-{[5x\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{-2}^{2}+5{\int }_{-2}^{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x) \\  & =\frac{1}{3\pi }(-(5(2)\operatorname{cos}⁡(3\pi )-5(-2)\operatorname{cos}⁡(-3\pi ))+\frac{10}{3\pi }{[\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{-2}^{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{3\pi }(20+\frac{10}{3\pi }(\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\pi )-\operatorname{sin}⁡(-3\pi ))) \\  & =\frac{1}{3\pi }\cdot 20 \\  & =\frac{20}{3\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$
